The '''LPL 2013 Spring''' was the first split of the [[LoL Pro League]] (''LPL'') season, organized by Tencent Games and Riot Games from 16 March to 23 June 2013 in Shanghai. Eight teams competed in a Quadruple Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo1}} Group Stage followed by a Single Elimination Playoffs bracket. Two teams—[[Royal Club]] and [[Team WE]]—entered through the [[Tencent_Games_Arena/City_Hero_Tournament/Season_3|TGA City Hero Tournament]], while the remaining six qualified via the [[LPL/2013/Spring/Qualifier|LPL 2013 Spring Qualifier]]: [[Invictus Gaming]], [[Oh My God]], [[Positive Energy]], [[Team Livemore]], [[Wayi Spider]], and [[Wings of Aurora]]. The top two teams from the Group Stage advanced to the [[World_Championship/2013/Regional_Finals/China|2013 China Regional Finals]].

==Format==
* '''Group Stage'''
**  Quadruple Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo1}}
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''1st till 4th place''}} advance to the Playoffs.
**** Top 2 in the group stage qualify for the [[World_Championship/2013/Regional_Finals/China|Regional Finals]]
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''5th and 6th place''}} qualify for [[LPL/2013/Summer|Summer season]].
*** {{bgcolortext|down|''7th and 8th place''}} are relegated from the league.
* '''Playoffs'''
**  Single elimination
** Semifinals and third place match are {{Abbr/Bo3}}
** Finals are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
